name: MetalGreymon
look: Greymon half rebuilt in steel: a steel helmet and horns, a steel chest plate with a glowing hatch, a huge steel Trident Arm with three long claws, tattered purple wings and red spines, its tail still striped
entry: Half its body has been rebuilt in metal. The hatch on its chest opens to fire Giga Destroyer, two organic missiles that can level a mountain, and its Trident Arm tears through steel.
how: Wild: ultra-rare on mountains, peaks and badlands.
Evolves into BlitzGreymon at level 45, learning Steel Beam.
